verdict.rationale: Publishing filing deadlines and penalty/interest schedules is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack gives deadline dates, late-filing penalty amounts, or interest rates. The Gateway and tax pages only mention portals, a forms library, and a missing-return notice. The Secretary of State's own sites returned 403 at robots.txt, so no fee or deadline content could be read.
